method: Phase 2a multi-track classification: per-lesson timestamped cue samples (first 30 / evenly-spaced middle / last 15 cues) classified by 10 parallel subagents from transcript content; instructor priors used only as defaults, content is authoritative. Samples: %TEMP%/class-samples/Lxx.md

track_definitions.GAME_DEVELOPMENT: Technical/engineering: programming, engines (C#, Unity, OpenGL/C++), physics, gameplay/animation/UI implementation, debugging, optimization, project builds
track_definitions.GAME_DESIGN: Design concepts: game history/genres, mechanics/rules/systems as design, player experience, balancing, level/progression design, narrative, documentation, design thinking, idea generation, prototyping/evaluation as design practice
track_definitions.CROSS_DISCIPLINARY: Lessons substantively bridging design and implementation (designing AND implementing mechanics, level design via engine tools, project lessons with both major); otherwise dominant side is primary and the other side a secondary track
